item.title: Israel signals limited reopening of Rafah crossing after captive recovery operation
item.description: Israel says it will allow a limited reopening of Gaza’s Rafah crossing with Egypt once efforts to recover the body of the last remaining Israeli captive are completed, tying the move to conditions on Hamas under the current ceasefire agreement.

item.title: Massive winter storm paralyses US travel and power networks
item.description: A vast winter storm swept across the United States over the weekend, bringing heavy snow, sleet and freezing rain that paralysed air travel, knocked out power supplies and left large swathes of the country grappling with dangerous cold.
